condition: Clozapine-induced myocarditis with acute left ventricular dysfunction
evaluationParameters: Trend troponin I and CRP for improvement or continued elevation.
Monitor cardiac and respiratory status, including heart rate/rhythm, oxygenation, dyspnea, crackles, edema, and LVEF.
missingInformation: Blood pressure, oxygen saturation, ECG and telemetry findings, baseline cardiac studies, cardiac MRI or other confirmatory testing, infectious evaluation, and provider orders; ANC 980/µL with fever and sore throat also requires urgent evaluation for concurrent clozapine-associated neutropenia and infection.
priorityActions: Urgently notify the prescribing provider and initiate emergency cardiac evaluation and supportive management.
reasoning: The timing after clozapine initiation plus systemic inflammation, myocardial injury, global ventricular dysfunction, pericardial effusion, and heart-failure findings strongly supports clozapine-induced myocarditis; the neutropenia may be concurrent but does not explain the cardiac findings.
